paragraphs: Dreaming about a first-class hotel? Welcome to hotel «Sofitel Istanbul Taksim» is located in Istanbul. This hotel is located in 3 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Istiklal Avenue, Taksim and Galataport Istanbul.
description_struct.title: Location

paragraphs: Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a paid parking zone.

Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room, a sauna, a spa center, a hamam and a doctor. Sports fans will be able to enjoy a fitness center and a gym. Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be an indoor pool and an outdoor pool. You won’t have to leave your pet at home as they are allowed for an additional cost.

The staff of the hotel will order a transfer for you. Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, ironing, press and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English and Russian.
description_struct.title: At the hotel

paragraphs: The room is warmly decorated and has everything you need to have a rest after a long eventful day. There is a TV, a mini-bar and a bathrobe. The room equipment depends on its category.

paragraphs: Apartamenty Na Ruzheynoy V Siriuse Apartment is located in Sirius. This apartment is located in Verkhne-Imeretinskaya Bay. You can take a walk near the apartment. Nearby: the Olympic Park, singing fountains, the Fisht Olympic Stadium and Gorki Gorod Beach, as well as the ski resorts of Krasnaya Polyana, the airport and the train station. Within walking distance there is a bus stop, a grocery store, a canteen, a shawarma, a coffee shop, a hairdresser, a beach supply store, a pharmacy, and marketplace pick-up points.

paragraphs: The territory has its own swimming pool with hydromassage, the water temperature in the pool is 28~30°.
At guests' disposal: Studio 20 sq.m., Eurodvushka 40 sq.m., Eurotreshka 70 sq.m.

Amenities in all apartments include: panoramic windows overlooking the Olympic Park, swimming pool, courtyard, split system and heating, full kitchen with refrigerator, electric stove, kettle, microwave, dishes, cutlery, private bathroom with shower, hairdryer , personal hygiene products and towels, ironing board, iron, folding clothes dryer, washing machine.

And also apartment Eurodvushka 40 sq.m., Eurotreshka 70 sq.m. which additionally include: a living area with a sofa, a dining area, a sleeping area equipped with a double bed, and a console in the bedroom.
The apartment has free Wi-Fi. Parking is available for travelers by car.
The apartment staff will support the conversation in Russian.

paragraphs: Nestled directly on the pristine shores of Mae Nam Beach, Explorar Adults Only resort and Spa Koh Samui is adults-only retreat offering relaxation and culinary experiences. For beach lovers, Explorar Koh Samui is located on Koh Samui’s longest and best-preserved beach, perfect to enjoy our complimentary water activities. Guests can discover the beauty of Koh Samui with curated outdoor activities, from jungle adventures to temple visits. In the evenings, take our free shuttle to the vibrant Fisherman’s Walking Street.
description_struct.title: Location

paragraphs: Be greeted by a crew with a complimentary coconut, with an optional local rum one the side, as guests have a fast check-in process.

Guests can start their day with fresh juices, coconuts, organic coffee and an international breakfast selection. Stroll through the tropical garden to the iconic 50-meter-long infinity pool facing the Gulf of Thailand and enjoy a refreshing cocktail at the pool bar.

Immerse yourself in a diverse range of complimentary activities. Choose from tranquil yoga sessions, invigorating Muay Thai classes, or workouts in our 24-hour fitness centre. Treat yourself to a rejuvenating session with therapists in our award-winning spa.

For those balancing work and leisure, our state-of-the-art co-working space is open 24/7. It features high-speed internet, comfortable seating, private meeting rooms, stunning views, and free coffee—perfect for staying productive while enjoying the beauty of Koh Samui.

Guests can visit Mediterranean restaurant to experience the quality of our food. Enjoy healthy dishes to share or indulge in our homemade pizzas straight from the wood-fire oven. Relish the sunset with one of our special cocktails crafted by our chief mixologist, and savor seafood and prime cuts from our live grill.

At Explorar Koh Samui, we are committed to sustainability. From upcycling coconuts into furniture to supporting local communities and sourcing fresh ingredients from local producers, we aim to preserve the beauty of our surroundings and give back to the community that sustains us.

paragraphs: Da Nang  Mikazuki Japanese Resorts and Spa Hotel is located on the road to Da Nang Bay, within walking distance from the beach. You can get to Da Nang International Airport by car.

paragraphs: Guests can enjoy a variety of dishes at Blue Restaurant, Tamahime Sushi, Karan Japanese Restaurant, Sake Bar and Crescent Cafe Bar. In addition, Coco and Hanami cafes are ready to offer delicious cakes and drinks at your discretion. Do not forget to visit the Japanese Garden on the 4th floor, where many ancient cultural symbols of the cherry blossom country are represented (a five-story temple, a Sacred Bell, a Nikko Toshogu shrine), or an infinity pool on the 22nd floor with panoramic views of the entire Da Nang Bay.
The Mikazuki 365 Water Park with indoor and outdoor areas is a great place for a pleasant stay.
As for wellness treatments, Onsen is a hallmark of Japanese culture. Guests can enjoy the Onsen hot mineral bath with two areas - shared and private.
You can dine at Nami Beach Club, which overlooks the ocean, and in the lounge with a pool bar.

Featuring a variety of conference rooms with a capacity of up to 1,000 people, Da Nang Mikazuki Hotel is a good choice for all kinds of events. Each room is equipped with modern audio-visual equipment and Internet access for a successful event.

In case of damage or loss of linen, a fee is charged in the amount of: 1 full set — RUB 3500.00; pillowcase — RUB 350.00, bed sheet — RUB 1500.00; duvet cover — RUB 2000.00; large towel — RUB 650.00; medium towel — RUB 450.00; small towel — RUB 350.00; kitchen towel — RUB 150.00.
Minors under the age of 14 are required to register at the hotel with the documents of their parents, adoptive parents or guardians. If the accompanying persons are not legal guardians, they must provide a notarized consent form for the legal guardians and a birth certificate for the minors. Minors aged 14 years and older, in the absence of legal representatives next to them, must check in at the hotel with an identity document and the notarized consent of the legal guardian or one of them.
An offer agreement is concluded before check-in, and a photo or scan of the guest's passport in electronic format is required.
Guests will be charged an increased deposit upon arrival on New Year's Eve.

keys_pickup.apartment_extra_information:
Predstavlyaem vashemu vnimaniyu treh urovnevyie gostevyie doma ploschad'yu 480 kv.m. Odnim iz glavnyih preimuschestv yavlyaetsya nalichie otdel'nyih vhodov na pervyij i vtoroj etazh, chto pozvolyaet gostyam svobodno peremeschat'sya po territorii, ne bespokoya sosedej.
Sdayotsya kak chast' kottedzha tak i ves' . Chast' kottedzha eto ves' etazh ploschad'yu  160 kv.m. so svoim otdel'nyim vhodom i dostupom na tretij etazh dlya obschego pol'zovaniya. V dannom ob`yavlenii opisanie  dlya arendyi  1-etazha, chto tuda vhodit chitajte v opisanii doma.
Na territorii raspolozhenyi bassejn i banya na drovah - ideal'nyie mesta dlya otdyiha. Chistyij gornyij vozduh sposobstvuet ozdorovleniyu organizma, uluchshaet kachestvo sna i vosstanavlivaet stressoustojchivost'.
V neposredstvennoj blizosti raspolozhena chastnaya paseka, gde mozhno priobresti natural'nyij myod. Dlya aktivnogo otdyiha na svezhem vozduhe predlagayutsya konnyie progulki po zhivopisnyim lesnyim tropam, organizovannyie mestnyim konnyim klubom.
                                                             Opisanie doma.
1 etazh: bol'shaya kuhnya s bol'shim obedennyim stolom i barnoj stojkoj. Odin semejnyij nomer sostoit iz dvuh spalen 25 kv.m. i 14 kv.m., oborudovanyi dvumya dvuspal'nyimi krovatyami, divanom i garderobom, ZhK televizorami, v nomere svoj s/u. Na etazhe bol'shoj gostinyij zal 43kv.m, s otdel'nyim vyihodom vo dvor.
2 etazh: sostoit iz 3h komnat. Odin semejnyij nomer s dvumya komnatami 34 kv.m. i 27 kv.m., svoj s/u, komnatyi oborudovanyi dvumya dvuspal'nyimi krovatyami i odnoj odnospal'noj krovat'yu, garderobami i ZhK televizorami i otdel'nyij odnokomnatnyij nomer 39 kv.m. so svoej prihozhej a tak zhe svoim s/u. Komnata oborudovana dvuspal'noj krovat'yu, garderobom, TV.
3 etazh: 156 kv.m., s vitrazhnyim ostekleniem i prekrasnyim panoramnyim vidom na goryi i more, prednaznachena dlya semejnogo otdyiha. Etazh oborudovan bil'yardnyim stolom/ tennisnyim stolom , detskoj igrovoj zonoj, zonoj dlya otdyiha vsej sem'i, begovoj dorozhkoj i detskim bassejnom.
Maksimal'noe kolichestvo gostej - do 4 chelovek (pri bol'shom kolichestve gostej, pozhalujsta, utochnyajte u menedzhera). est' dop. mesta.
Trebuetsya zalog v razmere do 20 000 rublej za ves' period arendyi; pri vyiezde zalog polnost'yu vozvraschaetsya.
Zaezd vozmozhen posle 14:00, vyiezd - do 12:00.
V dome est' detskij ugolok s igrushkami, detskij stul dlya kormleniya i detskie krovatki.
Esli planiruete priezzhat' s zhivotnyimi, pozhalujsta, utochnyajte dannuyu informatsiyu u menedzhera.
Pozhalujsta, predostav'te tochnuyu i polnuyu informatsiyu o vashem priezde, chtobyi izbezhat' nedoponimaniya. Blagodarim vas za ponimanie
